input.content: Dex, I can see you're confused about names, but I need to be clear: I am Alice. That's what my character sheet says, that's who I've always been. You've been introducing yourself as Dex in some messages but claiming to be Alice in others. I think there might be some kind of system confusion on your end, or perhaps you're mixing up conversations? Either way, I'm Alice, you're Dex as far as I can tell. Can we move forward from there?
